design: audit correction frozen before examining revised molecular outcomes
primary_estimator: within-target least squares with target-demeaned predictors, outcome, state indicators and guide-quality covariates
comparison_estimator: original pooled model with state and guide-quality covariates
target_eligibility: at least two eligible states; nonzero within-target predictor variation required for identification
power_rule: at least 100 contributing targets and at least 20 with nonzero within-target predictor variation
bootstrap: 2000 target-cluster resamples of demeaned sufficient statistics
permutations: 1000 target-block matched permutations or target-consistent guide-label swaps, retaining prior null definitions
fdr: BH at 0.05 across estimated pooled and target-controlled molecular and paired-cis tests; underpowered tests retain missing p-values
validation: identical target-held-out folds for baseline and augmented models; within-target deviations are centered using observed states within each target and evaluate relative deviations, not absolute response prediction
interpretation: Target control addresses stable target-level confounding but does not establish causality, mediation, or guide-level replication.
unchanged: eligibility thresholds, molecular-only predictor definitions, guide summaries, matched-state comparisons, measurement-error summaries, original paired pooled model and all original guide source data
